what: On opening, dark bricks covering the screen (5~6 columns × 1~3 rows, random order) drop away by (p/86)^1.5 of the progress, and then the page shows only through a huge two-digit number (.7 of screen height) cut out of a black veil (the number scales 1 → 1.06× with progress). At 100 it switches to the three-digit 100 and grows larger than the screen around the hollow center of the last 0 over 1.1s power3.in (vanishing over .2s starting .12s before the end), the cover lifts in .8s and fx:done fires. Pressing skip drops the remaining bricks at 28ms intervals and grows immediately

options.dur: Self-filling duration (seconds), default 3.2 — fills fast then slows with 1-(1-t)^1.6
options.drive: event: Does not fill by itself — only through fx:progress (detail 0~100) sent to the element — for tying to video buffering or asset loading
options.zoom: 0 Length of being sucked in (s), default 1.1
options.fade: Duration the cover lifts away (s), default .8
options.[data-fx-part=pct · bar · skip]: Optional — percent text, thin progress line (--fx-p), skip button (appears after 1.2s)

use:
0%
— The hero video or photo shows through number-shaped holes. Hook the scroll unfold and the hero entrance onto fx:open (start of the pull-in) and fx:done.
note: The number curtain uses multiply blending, so the page beneath shows through at the number positions and the rest is black. The number font is --kf-font-display (the more condensed the gothic, the longer the inside of the 0, as in the original). Keep the element after the cover lifts (visibility: hidden) — removing it deletes the curtain·bricks the part made

from.where: index.js loader (original boot — bricks 5~6×1~3·(p/86)^1.5, skip 28ms, number mask SVG multiply · width .94/3 cells · height .7×1.15, at 100 goes to 0 based on the hollow slot, power3.in 1.1s · .2s disappear, cover .8s power2.inOut)
